body_lead: Taking a step ahead in the adoption of the Artificial Intelligence (AI), Uttar Pradesh, the most populous state in India, is planning to build the country's first AI city in Lucknow. This city is intended to accommodate and foster the AI ecosystem, demonstrating a progressive approach compared to other states. A report vy Grand View Research estimates the worldwide AI market to be valued at $137 billion in 2022. The market is expected to grow at a compound annual growth rate of 37.3% from 2023 to 2030.
